name: Kim French
who: UK personal trainer behind the Believe by Kim French app, selling 40+ coached home/gym plans with macro-based nutrition guidance and progress tracking.
why: Runs one of the higher-grossing women's fitness apps in the 'busy mum' niche, with strong app-store ratings and a loyal repeat-subscriber base.

name: James Smith
who: British influencer and content-first coach who built James Smith Academy, an online platform with a team of coaches delivering personalized training plans and accountability.
why: Mega-reach myth-busting content funnels into a genuine coaching business run by a full coaching team, not just him.

name: Ben Carpenter
who: UK personal trainer and author of 'Everything Fat Loss' who sells online personal training and coaching packages.
why: Known for evidence-based, myth-debunking content layered on top of a real solo coaching practice.

name: Ulisses Jr
who: Natural-bodybuilding coach who runs Ulisses World, an online muscle-building academy enrolling clients from 60+ countries.
why: 25+ years of training experience turned into a large-scale international coaching academy backed by a major supplement sponsorship.

name: Simeon Panda
who: UK bodybuilder-influencer selling online training programs (Mass Gain Extreme, Fat Burn Extreme, Toned and Sexy) through simeonpanda.com.
why: One of the largest bodybuilding-adjacent reach numbers in the segment, monetized across apparel, supplements, and coaching programs.

name: Joe Delaney
who: Irish, Ibiza-based personal trainer selling personal training services and the structured 'Ibiza Shreds' upper/lower hypertrophy program.
why: Built a mid-size following around a genuinely followed, spreadsheet-backed training program plus direct PT sales.

name: Diren Kartal
who: Turkish-British coach offering 1:1 'Confidence Coaching' and the group program Progress247, built on over a decade of gym-floor coaching experience.
why: Claims 40,000+ people coached online, with a non-restrictive, sustainability-first approach that built strong cross-market (English + Turkish) reach.

name: Alex Crockford
who: UK trainer and founder of the CrockFit / Alex Crockford app, offering home and gym programs, coaching calls, community access, and fitness retreats.
why: Longest-running app in the set (PDF plans since 2015, app since 2018), with a durable coaching-plus-community model.

name: Meggan Grubb
who: Australian trainer and founder of the Beyond app, delivering coached training, nutrition, and mindset programs for women at every life stage.
why: Scaled a wellness app to 100,000+ members with a 4.8-star rating, centered on pregnancy and postpartum fitness.

name: Courteney Fisher
who: US fitness and Pilates coach behind 'Fit With Coco,' a patented 3-2-1 strength-and-Pilates method sold as ongoing programs and challenges.
why: Viral 3-2-1 workout format converted into a real, repeat-purchase coaching platform, not just a one-off trend.

name: Hattie Boydle
who: UK powerlifting/bodybuilding champion and coach running Flex Method, a team-coached program on strength, food relationship, and lifting confidence for women.
why: Competitive pedigree (2x world champion) paired with a genuinely coached client program, not just content.

name: Emma Storey-Gordon
who: Dundee-based coach running 1:1 online coaching plus two group coaching businesses (including the EC Method) and a separate nutrition-coaching business.
why: Runs several parallel, genuinely coached programs rather than one flagship product, with a recent 600+ client group-coaching intake.

name: Jordan Syatt
who: World-champion powerlifter and Westside Barbell-certified coach selling Syatt Fitness online barbell and nutrition coaching.
why: Rare combination of elite competitive record, a long-running individualized coaching practice, and comedic/educational content that built a large following.

name: Susan Niebergall
who: Certified personal trainer and strength coach running Susan Niebergall Fitness, a solo online weight-loss coaching practice.
why: Smaller, solo operation but a genuine ongoing coaching relationship rather than a templated program.

name: Jono Castano
who: Sydney-based trainer and founder of Acero, whose Acero Drip app sells 24/7 coaching access, workout programs, and a members' community.
why: Built a recognizable training brand (Acero) and converted it into an app-based coaching subscription business.

name: Leandro Twin
who: Brazilian physical-education specialist running a personal online/in-person 'assessoria' (coaching consultancy) with custom diet and training plans and biweekly follow-ups.
why: Two decades of bodybuilding/nutrition authority in the Brazilian market, with a hands-on consultancy he personally attends rather than a resold template.

name: Renato Cariani
who: Brazilian pro bodybuilder running a personalized 'consultoria' offering individualized training, nutrition, and monitoring, plus a new physical training center opening in 2026.
why: One of the largest reach numbers in the segment worldwide, backed by a real paid consultancy and a bricks-and-mortar training-center expansion.

name: Sophia Thiel
who: German fitness personality selling 'Healthy Inside Out,' a coached 12-week program (with Gymondo) covering kick-start, reshape, and maintenance phases plus 130+ recipes.
why: Germany's best-known women's transformation coach, rebuilt around a mental-health-forward, sustainable-habits program after years in the public eye.

name: Julian Zietlow
who: German coach and founder of vegan supplement brand Rocka Nutrition, selling the 'Size Zero 2.0' nutrition-and-training concept plus live mentoring sessions.
why: Smaller reach than the segment's leaders, but a real, named coaching concept with high audience engagement.
